To address this, we propose COLDSELECT, a joint verbalizer and instance selection approach that models data diversity.

Experiments on eight benchmarks demonstrate COLDSELECT's superiority in reducing uncertainty and enhancing generalization, outperforming baselines in verbalizer and few-shot instance selection for cold-start scenarios.
